newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta stocks end up, Sampoerna down.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta stocks end up, Sampoerna down.

text.p: Jakarta stocks edged higher at the close on Friday, while blue chip cigarette maker Sampoerna fell on talk of possible poor sales, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index rose 1.59 points, or 0.25 percent, to close at 637.15 points. Decliners led advancers by 63 to 56 with 69 issues unchanged.
Total turn-over was 388 billion rupiah against 389 billion rupiah on Thursday.
"Sentiment on selected blue chips appeared to have improved in late trading. This has helped the index to close in positive territory," one broker said.
Blue chips Telkom, Indofood, Indocement and Indosat made modest gains as their prices were considered to have bottomed out, brokers said.
Blue chip Sampoerna, however, came under pressure following market talk of possible poor sales in the first quarter.

"We heard a rumour that Sampoerna was likely to post below-expected first quarter results as the firm ... spent less than expected on excise stamp duties in the past three months," an analyst with a foreign brokerage firm said.
Another broker said Sampoerna's sales in January and February fell for the first time since 1992.
Sampoerna was not immediately available for comment, but the analyst said the firm was expected to announce its first quarter sales within the next two weeks.

Minor-sized poultry breeding firm Multibreeder was suspended just before midsession after it had risen 31.25 percent to 1,050 rupiah. Trading in the counter resumed just before the close and it fell to 1,000 rupiah but closed 200 up on the day.
Officials of the Jakarta Stock Exchange were not immediately available for comment.
Retailer Matahari was traded at 3,350 rupiah at the cross board, up from the previous 3,325 rupiah, with some 13 million shares changing hands, but details were not clear, brokers said.
Some 10 million Matahari shares were also traded on the cross board on Thursday.
